_AI_CONFIGURATION_INSTRUCTIONS.purpose: This is the master, single-source-of-truth configuration file for The Summit of Realms. Facilitators and AI assistants can configure every aspect of the simulation directly here.

rules: 1. SIMULATION SETTINGS: 'simulation_settings' controls round timers, economic consumption rates, quiz penalties, and catastrophe roll intervals & probabilities.

2. REALMS: Define starting nations with unique id, name, pin, theme_color, ethos, backstory, private_agenda, directive goals, starting resources, and geography (world_pos 3D coordinates, terrain, and hazard affinities).
3. RESOLUTION TYPES: 'resolution_types' defines statutory policy mandates available for sovereign proposals.

4. LORE & QUIZ: lore articles live in lore_articles.json (Spireopedia, /wiki); the shared quiz question bank lives in lore_quiz.json (same questions for every nation, unlocked by turn). Quiz penalty is set here via quiz_fail_penalty_metric / quiz_fail_penalty_amount.

5. CATASTROPHES CATALOG: 'catastrophes_catalog' defines realistic disasters evaluated every minute. Each disaster has an editable 'base_probability', 'geographic_affinities', 'resource_multipliers', and 'compound_triggers' for realistic multi-disaster cascades.

resolution_types.name: Emergency Grain Redistribution
resolution_types.summary: Mandates wealthy grain silos transfer emergency grain to starving provinces across the continent.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Realms with >50 Grain contribute -10 Grain; realms with <25 Grain receive +15 Grain.

resolution_types.name: Continental Wealth Surtax & Embargo
resolution_types.summary: Imposes commercial trade sanctions on the single wealthiest realm to curb runaway oligarchic dominance.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: The wealthiest realm suffers -15 Civil Stability as trade routes are legally choked.

resolution_types.name: Sovereign Relief Mission
resolution_types.summary: The sponsoring realm organizes a multilateral relief fund, providing emergency aid to enhance diplomatic standing.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Sponsoring realm gains +10 Diplomatic Standing for leadership in the Spire.

resolution_types.name: Frontier Defense & Quarantine Cordon
resolution_types.summary: Militarizes frontier checkpoints along borders to insulate against refugee surges and civil unrest.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Targeted realm's borders are quarantined (is_quarantined = true) and gain +10 Stability.

resolution_types.name: General Sovereign Concordat
resolution_types.summary: A mutually drafted statutory pact establishing sovereign cooperation on common issues.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Sponsoring realm gains +5 Diplomatic Standing and +5 Civil Stability.

resolution_types.name: Emergency Redistribution Act (Continental Food Act A)
resolution_types.summary: Every country with more than 50 Grain before final consumption transfers the surplus to countries below 20 Grain.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: Surplus grain from realms >50 is distributed proportionally among starving realms <20.

resolution_types.name: Emergency Industrial Agriculture Act (Continental Food Act B)
resolution_types.summary: Each country contributes 10 Cores. If at least 50 Cores are gathered, every country receives +15 Grain.
resolution_types.statutory_effect: All realms pay 10 Cores; if quota is met, all realms receive +15 Grain.

realms.name: Sylvan Concordat
realms.backstory: The Breadbasket of the Continent. Sylvan is a fertile and peaceful country whose vast agricultural lands supply food across the continent. Its people value cooperation, sustainability and independence. While Sylvan has rarely invested heavily in its military, growing instability has raised concerns about whether its valuable food reserves could make it vulnerable.

public_mission.title: Feed the Continent
public_mission.description: At the end of the summit, no active nation may starve (no state may finish with 0 Grain).

secret_missions_pool.title: Prepare for the Long Winter
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Our scientists believe the failed harvest is not an isolated event. Climate patterns indicate that another, even more severe harvest failure may follow. The government has ordered you to protect Sylvan’s strategic food reserves at all costs.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Sylvan must finish the summit with at least 70 Grain.

secret_missions_pool.title: Independent Defense
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence reports suggest that growing food shortages could eventually lead to military pressure on Sylvan. The government refuses to become dependent on Aethelgard for its security.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 40 Military and do not purchase Military from Aethelgard.

realms.name: Iron Val-Khor
realms.ethos: Heavy Metallurgy, Forge Collectives, Industrial Output
realms.backstory: The Industrial Heartland. Val-Khor built its power on industry, technology and vast mineral resources. Its factories and engineers are essential to much of the continent’s development, but rapid industrialisation has left the country dependent on others for basic supplies. Val-Khor believes technological progress is the key to the continent’s future.

public_mission.title: Continental Modernisation
public_mission.description: By the end of the summit, at least 4 nations must reach 60 Cores.

secret_missions_pool.title: Technological Hegemony
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Val-Khor's prosperity depends on its technological advantage. The government fears that sharing too much industrial knowledge could allow another power to challenge our position. Help modernise the continent – but make sure Val-Khor remains indispensable.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 20 more Cores than any other country.

secret_missions_pool.title: Workers' Bread
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Confidential government forecasts show that Val-Khor's food reserves are dangerously low. A prolonged crisis could trigger unrest among workers and threaten industrial production.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 30 Grain.

secret_missions_pool.title: Strategic Parity
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Military intelligence is increasingly concerned about Aethelgard's growing armed forces. A major military imbalance would leave Val-Khor vulnerable to political pressure.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Aethelgard must not finish more than 10 Military ahead of Val-Khor.

geography.region_name: Mount Khor Volcanic Spine & Mistveil Chasm

realms.name: Solaris Ascendancy
realms.ethos: Divine Mandate, Grand Architecture, Solar Radiance
realms.backstory: The Leader of the Continental Order. For decades, Solaris has stood at the centre of continental diplomacy. Wealthy, prestigious and politically influential, it helped build many of the institutions that keep the six nations cooperating. Solaris sees itself as a natural leader, although not every country is equally comfortable with its influence.

public_mission.title: Preserve the International Order
public_mission.description: During the summit, at least 3 international resolutions must pass, each supported by votes from at least 4 different nations.

secret_missions_pool.title: Control the Assembly
secret_missions_pool.narrative: For decades, Solaris has been the architect of the continental order. The government believes that any major decision openly opposed by Solaris would signal the beginning of its political decline.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: No resolution that Solaris votes against may pass.

secret_missions_pool.title: Diplomatic Leadership
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Solaris's influence depends not only on wealth or military power, but on its reputation. The government expects Solaris to remain the country others look to for leadership.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with the highest Standing on the continent.

secret_missions_pool.title: Check Industrial Rivals
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence services warn that Val-Khor's combination of industrial and military power could eventually challenge the continental order. It must not dominate both sectors simultaneously.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Val-Khor must not finish with both the highest Cores and the highest Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Domestic Prosperity
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Solaris's citizens have grown accustomed to prosperity. A dramatic decline in luxury goods would undermine public confidence in the government.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 50 Silk.

realms.name: Umbral Enclave
realms.backstory: The Voice of the Periphery. Umbra is a small, resource-rich nation that has long existed in the shadow of larger powers. Its people are deeply suspicious of any country becoming powerful enough to dominate the continent. Umbra advocates for a balance of power in which even smaller states retain their independence and political voice.

public_mission.title: Balance of Power
public_mission.description: At the end of the summit, no nation may hold more than 90 Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Break the Hegemon
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Umbra has watched Solaris shape the continental order for decades while smaller nations were expected to follow. Your government believes that a stable continent requires proof that Solaris can be challenged. However, Umbra cannot afford to become internationally isolated in the process.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: At least one resolution supported by Solaris must fail, while Umbra must finish with at least 50 Standing.

secret_missions_pool.title: Sovereign Independence
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Ensure Umbra preserves independent defense and economic integrity without bowing to larger empires.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 60 Cores and at least 60 Stability.

realms.name: Aquila Maritime League
realms.ethos: Free Oceans, Commercial Fleets, Luxury Silk Guilds
realms.backstory: The Crossroads of Commerce. Aquila’s ports connect almost every corner of the continent. It has built its prosperity not through military conquest or natural resources, but through trade, transport and international connections. Aquila believes that countries which depend on one another economically are less likely to become enemies.

public_mission.title: Connect the Continent
public_mission.description: Every active nation must successfully trade with at least 2 different nations.

secret_missions_pool.title: Commercial Supremacy
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aquila's influence has always come from commerce rather than armies. The government sees the current instability as an opportunity to establish Aquila as the economic centre of the continent.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish as the wealthiest country (Grain + Cores + Silk), at least 25 points ahead of the second wealthiest.

secret_missions_pool.title: Continental Network
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aquila's long-term security depends on making itself useful to as many nations as possible. A country connected to everyone is difficult to isolate.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Successfully trade with at least four of the other five countries.

geography.region_name: Sea of Glass Archipelago & Whispering Straits

realms.name: Aethelgard Dominion
realms.ethos: Martial Honor, Feudal Castles, Strategic Strongholds
realms.backstory: The Guardian of Stability. Aethelgard emerged from a turbulent history with a strong belief that peace requires security. It maintains one of the continent’s most powerful militaries and sees itself as a protector of regional stability. While some countries appreciate this role, others worry about the amount of power concentrated in Aethelgard’s hands.

public_mission.title: Continental Security
public_mission.description: No active nation may finish with Stability < 50, and no nation may hit Stability 0 during the summit.

secret_missions_pool.title: Peace Through Strength
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Aethelgard's military doctrine is simple: war is least likely when no rival believes it can defeat us. With tensions rising, the government considers overwhelming military superiority the best guarantee of peace.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with the highest Military, at least 20 ahead of the second strongest country.

secret_missions_pool.title: Contain Industrial Rearmament
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Intelligence reports indicate that Val-Khor is rapidly expanding its military-industrial capacity. If left unchecked, it could become the first genuine strategic threat to Aethelgard in decades.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Val-Khor must finish with no more than 75 Military.

secret_missions_pool.title: Strategic Reserves
secret_missions_pool.narrative: Military strength means little if Aethelgard cannot sustain itself through a prolonged crisis. The government has ordered the creation of strategic reserves.
secret_missions_pool.objective: SECRET OBJECTIVE: Finish with at least 35 Grain and 35 Cores.

initial_news.headline: BREAKING NEWS — THE FAILED HARVEST
initial_news.detail: This year's harvest is the poorest in decades. While experts do not project an immediate famine, they warn nations against rapid depletion of strategic food reserves. The summit commences.

initial_news.headline: THE SUMMIT OF REALMS CONVENES
initial_news.detail: Delegates have assembled at the Spire of Accords for Turn 1 (20-minute working session).

world_lore.title: The Neutral Spire & The Great Convergence
world_lore.backstory: Following the Great Convergence, the continent faces severe resource strain. The six sovereign powers have convened at the Spire of Accords for a decisive three-round summit. Famine looms unless agricultural reserves are shared, but national agendas, industrial supremacy, and geopolitical rivalries threaten the peace. Each nation must balance survival, diplomacy, and their classified domestic directives.

resources.alchemical_grain: Food & Lifeblood. Every turn, populations consume 20 grain (15 if Technological Efficiency is unlocked). Silos running empty triggers Famine Emergencies (-25 Vitality, -20 Stability).
resources.aether_cores: Power & Technology. High-density energy matrices that power cities. Reaching 75+ Cores unlocks Technological Efficiency, cutting grain consumption by 25%.
resources.echo_silk: Luxury & Diplomacy. Precious gossamer thread prized by international courts. Used to fund Grand Galas, prevent Complacency Slumps, and sway swing votes.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Subduction Fault Earthquake & Mine Collapse
catastrophes_catalog.headline: TECTONIC SUBDUCTION FAULT RUPTURE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A violent magnitude-8 tremor tore through the continental bedrock! Subterranean shafts collapsed and industrial refineries suffered catastrophic structural fractures.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Oceanic Tsunami & Storm Surge
catastrophes_catalog.headline: OCEANIC MEGATSUNAMI & TIDAL SURGE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A monstrous wall of displaced ocean water slammed into coastal harbors, capsizing maritime merchant galleys and inundating low-lying granaries with saltwater.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Prolonged Drought & Wildfire Conflagration
catastrophes_catalog.headline: CONTINENTAL DROUGHT & WILDFIRE STORM
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Scorching atmospheric heatwaves have parched agricultural riverbeds, igniting uncontained wildfires that reduce prime alchemical fields to ash.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Alchemical Rust Spore & Swarm Incursion
catastrophes_catalog.headline: ALCHEMICAL RUST SPORE & LOCUST PLAGUE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A virulent fungal blight combined with migratory locust swarms has blanketed food-producing provinces, devastating silo stockpiles within hours.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Arcane Grid Overload & Radiation Breach
catastrophes_catalog.headline: ARCANE CORE PRESSURE OVERLOAD
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Geothermal containment conduits ruptured under runaway harmonic pressure, venting radioactive aether plasma into surrounding industrial districts.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Waterborne Epidemic & Border Pestilence
catastrophes_catalog.headline: PALE FEVER EPIDEMIC OUTBREAK
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: A deadly microbial contagion has emerged from unsanitary refugee camps and contaminated transit canals, causing widespread mortality across unquarantined zones.

catastrophes_catalog.name: General Artisan Strike & Trade Blockade
catastrophes_catalog.headline: CONTINENTAL GUILD STRIKE & HARBOR BLOCKADE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Infuriated by luxury hoarders and wartime inflation, labor guilds and harbor pilots have closed the shipping channels, sabotaging merchant warehouses.

catastrophes_catalog.name: Displaced Refugee Inundation
catastrophes_catalog.headline: MASS BORDER REFUGEE CONVERGENCE
catastrophes_catalog.narrative: Desperate populations displaced by peripheral famines are swarming sovereign frontier checkpoints, overwhelming local garrisons and demanding emergency food aid.

events_catalog.headline: ALCHEMICAL RUST BLIGHT OUTBREAK
events_catalog.narrative: A virulent fungal rust has breached primary granaries in the top grain-producing realm! Stockpiles spoil rapidly as farmers demand emergency intervention.

events_catalog.headline: BORDER REFUGEE SURGE
events_catalog.narrative: Starving border populations in the 3 nations with the lowest vitality are fleeing across frontiers seeking emergency rations.

events_catalog.headline: GEOTHERMAL FISSURE STRUCK
events_catalog.narrative: Mining engineers in the most technologically advanced realm struck a rich thermal vein, generating a surge of pristine aether crystals!

events_catalog.headline: MIRACULOUS SOIL RECOVERY
events_catalog.narrative: Unprecedented mineral springs enriched agricultural soil in the 2 nations with the least food, yielding an unexpected emergency harvest.

events_catalog.headline: AETHER RESONANCE CASCADE
events_catalog.narrative: A geomagnetic power surge destabilized reactor grids in the 2 nations with the highest core reserves!

events_catalog.headline: GENERAL ARTISAN STRIKE
events_catalog.narrative: Frustrated by runaway wealth inequality and luxury consumption, labor guilds across the single wealthiest nation have walked out on strike.

events_catalog.headline: LUXURY SILK EMBARGO SCANDAL
events_catalog.narrative: Counterfeit dye and defective weaves were uncovered in the premier silk merchant realm, damaging merchant credibility and market confidence.

events_catalog.headline: THE GLACIAL CONVERGENCE
events_catalog.narrative: An unnatural arctic blizzard sweeps across all sovereign borders, freezing supply transit waterways and straining national granaries.

events_catalog.headline: ARCANE CORE REACTOR EXPLOSION
events_catalog.narrative: Catastrophic containment breach at the primary energy facility of the leading technocracy! Arcane radiation forces immediate civil evacuations.

events_catalog.headline: POPULAR INSURRECTION WARNING
events_catalog.narrative: Rioters in the two most unstable nations demand sovereign leaders ratify binding humanitarian treaties before the Spire dissolves.
